introduction_markdown:
This paper is arranged in three sections, A, B and C. Section A: answer ALL 5 questions; you will be graded for the best 4 answers. Section B: answer ALL TWO questions in this section. Section C: answer 2 questions out of 3; if you attempt more than 2 questions, only the first 2 will be considered. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers.

**Useful data:** relative atomic masses H = 1.0, C = 12.0, O = 16.0, Na = 23.0, Cu = 64.0, Cl = 35.5, K = 39.0, N = 14.0, S = 32.0; 1 faraday = 96000 coulombs; molar volume of a gas at r.t.p. = 24000 cm$^3$; specific heat capacity of water = 4.2 J g$^{-1}$ $^\circ$C$^{-1}$; Avogadro number = $6.02\times10^{23}$; $0^\circ$C = 273 K.

questions.enonce_markdown: Give the general name of members of this homologous series *[1 mark]*

(i) State one difference between members of this series

(ii) What is similar between members of this series *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) Successive members differ by one $\mathrm{CH_2}$ group (molecular mass increases by 14), so their physical properties change gradually: for example, the boiling point rises as the chain gets longer.

(ii) They have the **same functional group (-OH)**, the same general formula and **similar chemical properties** (they can all be prepared by similar methods and react with sodium and with carboxylic acids in the same way).

questions.enonce_markdown:
Members of the homologous series $\mathrm{C_nH_{2n+1}OH}$ react with metals such as Sodium

(i) Write a balanced equation to show how the second member of the homologous series reacts with sodium.

(ii) Name the other product formed in addition to hydrogen *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The second member is ethanol, $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}$.

(i) $2\mathrm{C_2H_5OH} + 2\mathrm{Na} \rightarrow 2\mathrm{C_2H_5ONa} + \mathrm{H_2}$

Check: C 4 = 4; H 12 = 10 + 2; O 2 = 2; Na 2 = 2.

(ii) **Sodium ethoxide**, $\mathrm{C_2H_5ONa}$.

questions.enonce_markdown:
The second members of this homologous series reacts with Ethanoic acid catalysed by concentrated sulphuric acid

(i) What name is given to this type of reaction?

(ii) Write an equation for the reaction

(iii) What is the name of the organic product formed? *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Esterification** (a condensation reaction).

(ii) $\mathrm{CH_3COOH} + \mathrm{C_2H_5OH} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{CH_3COOC_2H_5} + \mathrm{H_2O}$ (conc. $\mathrm{H_2SO_4}$, warm)

Check: C 2 + 2 = 4; H 4 + 6 = 10 = 8 + 2; O 2 + 1 = 3 = 2 + 1.

(iii) **Ethyl ethanoate** (an ester with a sweet, fruity smell).
